run_check_include_guards: run the include guard checker on all C header files in the gRPC repository
run_check_include_guards_fix: run the include guard checker with the --fix flag to automatically correct invalid guards
run_check_include_guards_precommit: run the include guard checker in precommit mode to check only changed files
build_valid_guard: build the expected preprocessor guard name from a given C header file path
GuardValidator_check: check a single C header file for correct ifndef, define, and endif preprocessor guards
